senses.gloss:
तुश् 1. तुश्, cl. 1. A., Ved. तोशते, &c., to drip,
trickle; sprinkle; (Sāy.) to be struck; to
be pressed out or extracted; to be drunk; [cf. तोश
and तोशस्.]

तुश् 2. तुश् (for तुष् ?), cl. 1. A., Ved. तो-
सते, &c., to quiet, pacify, appease, satisfy.

तुष् तुष् [cf. rt. 1. जुष्], cl. 4. P. (ep.
also A.) तुष्यति, -ते, तुतोष, तोक्ष्यति,
अतुषत्, तोष्टुम्, to become tranquil or calm or
quiet; to be contented or satisfied, to be pleased or
delighted with anything or any person (with inst.,
gen., loc. or प्रति after the acc., e. g. दत्तेन
तुष्यति, he is satisfied with the gift; तस्य or
तेन or तस्मिन् or तम् प्रति तुष्यामि, I am
pleased with him); to satisfy, please (with acc.,
e. g. सा पतिं न तुतोष, she did not please her
husband): Caus. P. तोषयति, -यितुम्, to make
satisfied, satisfy, please, gratify, gladden, quiet, calm,
appease, pacify; to gratify any one with anything
(with acc. of the person and inst. of the thing,
e. g. तोषय हरं तपसा, gratify Śiva with
penance; आत्मानम् तोषयति, he satisfies himself,
he becomes satisfied): Desid. तुतुक्षति: Intens.
तोतुष्यते, तोतोष्टि; [cf. तूष्णीम्; cf. also Lith.
têsziju, ‘to recreate, to refresh;’ Lat. taceo; Goth.
thahan.]
तुस् तुस्, cl. 1. P. तोसति, &c., to sound.

तूष् तूष् (= तुष्), cl. 1. P. तूषति, &c.,
to be satisfied or pleased; to satisfy.

तुषित, आस्, m. pl. a class of subordinate deities,
thirty-six in number (sometimes reckoned as twelve
in number and identified with the twelve Ādityas);
N. of twelve sons of Bhaga-vat; (अस्), m. a N. of
Viṣṇu (one of the Ādityas); (आ), f., N. of the
wife of Veda-śiras and mother of the god Vibhu.
—तुषित-कायिक, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the
body or class of the Tuṣitas.
तुषित तुषित, तुष्टि, &c. See under rt. तुष्.

तुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, satisfied, contented, pleased,
glad, &c.
—तुष्ट-धी, धीस्, धीस्, धि, pleased in
mind, satisfied.

तुष्टि, इस्, f. satisfaction, gratification, content-
ment, pleasure; acquiescence, indifference to every-
thing but that possessed, (the Sāṅkhya phil. reckons
nine kinds of Tuṣṭi); Contentment personified as
a daughter of Dakṣa and mother of Santoṣa or
Muda; N. of a daughter of Kaśyapa; of a deity
sprung from the Kalās of Prakṛti and wife of
Ananta; of a Mātṛkā; of one of the Kalās of the
moon.
—तुष्टि-कर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, causing satis-
faction, pleasing, gratifying, satisfying.
—तुष्टि-ज-
नन, अस्, ई, अम्, or तुष्टि-द, अस्, आ, अम्, giving
or producing satisfaction, affording pleasure, gratify-
ing.
—तुष्टि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, pleased, gratified;
(आन्), m., N. of a prince, a son of Ugra-sena.
तुष्ट्वा, ind. having pleased or satisfied.

तुष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be satisfied or gratified,
easily satisfied; an epithet of Śiva.

तुष तुष, अस्, m. (perhaps connected with
त्वच्), the husk or chaff of grain, of corn, rice, &c.
[cf. अ-तुष, उत्-तुष, निस्-तुष, तुच्छ]; Beleric
Myrobalan, Terminalia Bellerica.
—तुष-ग्रह,
अस्, m. Agni or fire (‘seizing the husk’).
—तुष-
ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced from husk or chaff.
—तुषज-क, अस्, m., N. of a Śūdra.
—तुष-
धान्य, अम्, n. a leguminous plant; N. of a place.
—तुष-वन, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a
place; (a various reading has तुंव-वन.)
—तु-
ष-सार, अस्, m. (= तुष-ग्रह), Agni or fire.
—तुषाग्नि (˚ष-अग्˚), इस्, m. or तुषानल (˚ष-
अन्˚), अस्, m. a conflagration of chaff or of the husk
of corn; a capital punishment which consists in
twisting dry straw &c. round the limbs of a criminal
and setting it on fire.
—तुषाम्बु (˚ष-अम्˚), उ,
n. sour rice or barley-gruel.
—तुषोत्थ (˚ष-उत्˚),
अस्, m. or तुषोदक (˚ष-उद्˚), अम्, n. sour rice-
gruel or barley-gruel, (‘made from husk.’)

तुस तुस, अस्, m. the husk of corn or rice,
= तुष, q. v.

तूष तूष, अस्, अम्, m. n., Ved. a lappet,
the border or fringe of a garment.
तुषस्प तुषस्प, अस्, m., N. of a man.

तुषार तुषार, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
तुष्), cold, frigid, frosty, dewy; (अस्), m. frost,
cold; ice, snow, mist, dew, thin rain; N. of a place
mentioned in the Śrī-ṣavāyaṇa or part of the
Romaka-siddhānta; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a race; [cf.
तुहिन; cf. also Angl. Sax. thystre, thystrian,
theostre, theosterlic.]
—तुषार-कण, अस्, m. a
[]
dew-drop, an icicle, hoar frost.
—तुषार-काल, अस्,
m. winter, the cold season.
—तुषार-किरण, अस्,
m. the moon (‘having cold rays’).
—तुषार-गिरि,
इस्, m. the snowy mountain, the Himālaya.
—तुषा-
र-गौर, अस्, ई, अम्, white as snow, white with
snow; camphor.
—तुषार-रश्मि, इस्, m. the moon;
[cf. तुषार-किरण.]
—तुषाराद्रि (˚र-अद्˚), इस्,
m. or तुषार-पर्वत or तुषार-शैल, अस्, m.
the Himālaya mountain.
तुष्टु तुष्टु, उस्, m. a jewel worn in the ears.

तुस्त तुस्त, अस्, अम्, m. n. dust; husk; (a
various reading for बुस्त); [cf. तूस्त; Angl. Sax.
and Eng. dust.]

तूष्णीम् तूष्णीम्, ind. (fr. rt. तुष् with the
termination नीम्, as in इदानीम्, तदानीम्, &c.; cf.
जोषम् fr. rt. 1. जुष्), silent, in silence, silently,
quietly, still, softly, without speaking, without noise.
—तूष्णीं-शंस, अस्, m., Ved. silent recitation,
certain formulas or verses to be recited; [cf. Russ.
tishina, ‘silence, tranquillity:’ Lith. tylà, ‘silence;’
tylù, ‘to be silent:’ Hib. tosd, ‘silence, taciturnity;’
tosdadh, ‘silencing, confutation.’]
—तूष्णीं-शील,
अस्, आ, अम्, silent, taciturn.
—तूष्णीङ्-गङ्गम्, ind.
(a place) where the Ganges flows silently.
—तूष्णीम्-
भाव, अस्, m. the being silent, silence, taciturnity;
(rarely spelt तुष्णी-भाव.)
—तूष्णीम्-भूत, अस्,
आ, अम्, being silent, silent.
—तूष्णीम्-भूय, अस्,
आ, अम्, become silent.
—तूष्णी-शील = तूष्णीं-
शील, (perhaps a wrong reading.)

तूष्णीक, अस्, आ, अम्, silent, taciturn; (अम् or
आम्), ind. silently, quickly.
